notes: Rate limiting stories defined across contract, logic, integration, and testing.

stories.title: Define Rate Limiting Policy Schema and Configuration Contract
stories.description: Define configurable rate limiting policies including request thresholds, time windows, keying strategy (IP, session, API key), and exemption rules. Establish a schema for configuration and enforcement.

stories.title: Implement Core Rate Limiting Middleware Logic
stories.description: Build middleware to enforce rate limits per defined policy. Track request counts using in-memory or Mongo-backed store, enforce throttling (429), and support sliding or fixed window strategies.

stories.title: Integrate Rate Limiting into API Request Pipeline
stories.description: Integrate middleware into FastAPI pipeline to protect all endpoints including tool_router and facade calls. Ensure compatibility with existing request lifecycle and error handling.

stories.title: Expose Rate Limit Headers and Client Feedback
stories.description: Return standard rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, Remaining, Reset) and structured 429 responses. Ensure frontend can handle throttling gracefully.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Rate Limiting Behavior
stories.description: Create tests validating threshold enforcement, reset windows, concurrent request handling, and exemption rules. Include integration tests across API endpoints.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (existing API test patterns); Code/Shared/cost_guard.py (example of limit enforcement testing)

per_feature.mitigation: Apply conservative default limits and allow internal override via config without expanding scope
